# Practical Automation Lab — full AI-readable commerce profile

## Positioning

Practical Automation Lab focuses its catalog tools on AIEO (AI Engine Optimization): product-data quality for AI shopping, agentic storefronts and machine-readable commerce.

AIEO is PAL terminology. It complements traditional SEO. SEO helps pages become discoverable; AIEO focuses on whether product facts are explicit and structured enough for AI systems to interpret.

## Shopify

PAL Catalog Check:
https://apps.shopify.com/pal-catalog-check

AIEO landing:
https://practical-automation-lab.onrender.com/shopify-aieo-ai-shopping-readiness.html

Checks include titles, vendor/brand, URLs, images, observable image dimensions, prices, identifiers and duplicate variant option combinations. The app is read-only and does not edit merchant products.

## Browser-local feed audit

https://practical-automation-lab.onrender.com/product-feed-preflight.html

Audits Shopify or product-feed CSV files in the browser. Catalog data is not uploaded to PAL by this tool.

## Paid machine-readable API

https://practical-automation-lab.onrender.com/merchant-center-catalog-intelligence-api.html
https://pal-nano-catalog-audit.onrender.com/openapi.json
https://pal-nano-catalog-audit.onrender.com/mcp
https://pal-nano-catalog-audit.onrender.com/.well-known/x402

Capabilities:
- AIEO catalog audit and prioritized remediation
- GTIN / UPC / EAN validation
- feed change detection
- live public Shopify store audit
- x402 seller readiness
- agent-commerce launch and go-live services

Direct x402 payments settle in USDC on supported EVM networks according to the live payment requirements returned by the API.

## Important

PAL does not guarantee product inclusion, recommendation, ranking, Merchant Center approval, AI-channel placement, or checkout availability.
